description.narrative: Contract related to: Projet d¿appui ¿a police nationale d¿Ha¿ et au contr¿des fronti¿s - The current crisis in Haiti is one of the worst witnessed by the country in its recent history and is worsening day by day. Insecurity is spreading across the country and law and order have all but collapsed. The national police is overwhelmed, underequipped and outnumbered, with criminal armed groups expanding their territorial control throughout the capital and other regions. Security sector reform in general, and a strengthened national police in particular, are key to ensuring that the country can embark on the road to stability. Improving the security situation is also a pre-requisite for holding elections. The action will therefore contribute to accompanying and supporting the National Police of Haiti in its response to the urgent security challenges in the country, including the fight against organised crime, and with a view to re-establishing its capacity to effectively ensure public order and individual security.
